description: A FILE standing where the parent directory belongs is a broken tree, not a fresh branch. Reading it blank would invite a patch to write into a path that cannot hold a document. PLATFORM DIVERGENCE, recorded rather than papered: this refusal depends on the OS reporting a path-through-a-file as something other than a missing file. Where the OS reports it as merely missing, the missing-file-reads-blank rule cannot tell the two apart and the read answers blank. The runner MEASURES which world it is in instead of reading a platform string, and asserts the matching answer either way.
notes: Divergence 2. Rust already refused; python read it blank until this corpus ruled on it.
